name: Simple-Organizer
description: Simple Organizer is the first Step of the Simple-Project.
readme_summary: Simple Organizer is a Python-based application for automatic file organization on Linux and Windows. It offers features like sub-categorization, a rules engine, undo functionality, scheduling, and duplicate detection/deletion, all designed for safety and reliability with no internet or background services required.
primary_use_case: Automating the organization of files on a user's computer system.
cover_image_prompt: A meticulous librarian meticulously sorting a chaotic avalanche of books, papers, and digital files into perfectly organized shelves and digital folders. Each item is clearly labeled, and a subtle digital aura surrounds the librarian, hinting at advanced automation. Small, glowing icons representing rules, schedules, and duplicate checks float around the scene. The background is a clean, modern library interior with a soft, organized glow. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, friendly aesthetic, emphasizing order and efficiency.

name: edentext
description: Powerful local Word Processor for docx and odt.  Free, Open Source, Private by Design
readme_summary: EdenText is a powerful, free, and open-source web-based word processor designed for local-first operation. It allows users to create and edit documents in .docx and .odt formats directly in their browser, ensuring privacy as all processing happens client-side and documents never leave the user's computer. It aims to provide a rich feature set comparable to desktop applications while being accessible via a single URL or as a slim offline app.
key_features: Real page layout (A4/Letter, margins, headers/footers, footnotes, columns, page/line numbering, watermarks)
Opens and saves .odt and .docx, exports PDF
Compatibility with Word and LibreOffice document layouts
Advanced styling for paragraphs, characters, tables, and lists
Table features including styles, sorting, and spreadsheet-style formulas
Thesis writing support (table of contents, captions, cross-references, bibliography, index, LaTeX formulas)
Review tools (track changes, comments, spell check, grammar check)
Private by design, all processing runs locally, works offline
Support for current browsers with different save behaviors
primary_use_case: A private, local-first, feature-rich word processing application accessible through a web browser, designed for creating and editing documents without server-side processing or data transmission.
cover_image_prompt: A digital alchemist in a clean, minimalist workshop, holding a glowing, open book representing a .docx file. With a gentle wave of their hand, intricate digital particles representing text, images, and formatting flow from the book onto a pristine A4 page floating in front of them, forming a perfectly laid-out document with headers and footers. Subtle UI elements of EdenText, like a style selector or track changes indicator, are visible on a small, integrated screen. The overall mood is one of secure creation and effortless transformation, emphasizing privacy and power. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with soft, natural lighting and a clean, modern color palette.

name: dlss5-visual-enhancer
description: DLSS 5 Neural Rendering for Images & Video with Frame Generation, RTX Video Super Resolution, HDR, and Live Playback
readme_summary: Visual Enhancer is a Windows application that leverages NVIDIA DLSS 5 Neural Rendering and other AI upscaling technologies for enhancing the quality of images and videos. It offers a configurable pipeline with stages like DLSS Super Resolution, RTX Video Super Resolution, and Frame Generation, with live playback capabilities for local and online content.
key_features: DLSS 5 Neural Rendering via Neuroframe Engine
Configurable image and video processing pipelines
Live playback for local videos and online streams
primary_use_case: AI-assisted enhancement of images and videos using NVIDIA DLSS technologies on Windows.
cover_image_prompt: A master artisan, akin to a sculptor, meticulously chiseling a rough, pixelated block of stone (representing a low-quality image/video) into a pristine, high-definition sculpture that glows with vibrant detail. The artisan uses tools that subtly resemble NVIDIA DLSS and RTX interfaces, with digital particles of light flowing from the tools onto the sculpture. In the background, a holographic display shows the original pixelated input transforming into the sharp, detailed output. The scene is set in a futuristic workshop with clean lines and dramatic, focused lighting, emphasizing the transformation. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a sophisticated, tech-infused aesthetic, clearly visualizing the enhancement process.

name: apex-parser
readme_summary: The apex-parser repository is a Python-based tool designed to parse and manage lists of proxy servers. It categorizes proxies into whitelist, blacklist, and a full list, offering them in various formats like Base64, Plain, and YAML. The project aims to facilitate internet freedom by providing access to functional proxy lists.
key_features: Categorization into Whitelist, Blacklist, and Full List
Support for multiple output formats (Base64, Plain, YAML)
Distribution via GitHub raw content and CDNs
primary_use_case: To provide users with curated and categorized lists of functional proxy servers for bypassing censorship and enhancing internet freedom.
cover_image_prompt: A digital cartographer meticulously drawing a complex network of interconnected pathways on an ancient map. Some pathways glow green, representing 'whitelisted' routes, while others are marked with a red 'X' for 'blacklisted' routes. The cartographer uses a quill pen that emits streams of data, transforming raw information into clear, navigable routes. In the background, a subtle digital interface shows the repository name 'apex-parser' and different data format icons (Base64, YAML). The scene is set in a dimly lit study with a single beam of light illuminating the map, rendered in a detailed digital painting style with a focus on clear lines and a sense of discovery.
